mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact reconstruction of finite-field signatures from nonsingular principal minors, perfect-matching encodings of alternating signatures, injectivity of encodings, and the strengthened geometric bounds
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact finite fields and rational numbers
mathematics.conventions: Skew rank 2g counts bounded by (L^5+L^4)^g; generic symmetric rank r counts bounded by binom(2L,r)L^(2r)

bounds.skew: p=3,5; all 9 long-cycle classes and every tau already recorded in run/result.json, total L<=8
bounds.generic: p=3,5; b=2 generic seed; all sigma types and all tau at 1<=L<=4
bounds.geometric: All exact Gaussian and collision polynomials in run/result.json at N=p^(2d), 1<=d<=12 with (L^5+L^4)/N<1

non_claims: Finite encoding checks do not prove the universal enumeration bound
